required.quote: The applicant has had 1 year of experience. This experience shall include providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills all of which was supervised by a United States certified public accountant
required.citation: § 107. Requirements and qualifications for a permit to practice as a certified public accountant [Effective until July 1, 2026].

experience_source.quote: The applicant has had 1 year of experience. experience_source.citation: § 107. Requirements and qualifications for a permit to practice as a certified public accountant [Effective until July 1, 2026].

duration.value: 1 year (CPA pre-2026 and post-2026 under §107(c)(1) or (c)(2)); 2 years (CPA post-2026 under §107(c)(3))
duration.quote: the applicant has had 1 year of experience if applying for a permit based on the educational requirement under paragraph (c)(1) or (c)(2) of this section, and the applicant has had 2 years of experience if applying for a permit based on the educational requirement under paragraph (c)(3) of this section
duration.citation: § 107. Requirements and qualifications for a permit to practice as a certified public accountant [Effective July 1, 2026].

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.notes: Required for CPA permit; applicant may not sit until completing at least 120 semester hours including a baccalaureate degree (pre-2026); post-2026, must have a baccalaureate or higher degree before sitting.
exams.quote: The applicant has successfully passed the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and/or such successor examinations as may be required to qualify for a permit to practice
exams.citation: § 107. Requirements and qualifications for a permit to practice as a certified public accountant [Effective until July 1, 2026].

exams.name: AICPA self-study course and examination in professional ethics
exams.notes: Required for both CPA and PA permits.
exams.quote: The applicant has successfully passed the AICPA self-study course and examination in professional ethics
exams.citation: § 107. Requirements and qualifications for a permit to practice as a certified public accountant [Effective until July 1, 2026].

exams.name: Examination recognized by the National Society of Public Accountants (NSPA)
exams.notes: Required for PA permit (alternatively, FAR and AUD portions of the Uniform CPA Examination may satisfy this requirement).
exams.quote: Has passed either all parts of the examination recognized by the National Society of Public Accountants or both the Financial Accounting and Reporting (FAR) and Auditing and Attestation (AUD) portions of the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.citation: § 110. Requirements for permits to practice public accountancy.

interval_years.quote: Permits to practice shall be renewed biennially.
interval_years.citation: § 108. Issuance and renewal of CPA permits to practice and maintenance of competency; reciprocity [Effective until July 1, 2026].

required.quote: An applicant for renewal of a permit under this section shall show that the applicant has completed no less than 80 hours of continuing professional education as determined by Board rule during the 2-year renewal period
required.citation: § 108. Issuance and renewal of CPA permits to practice and maintenance of competency; reciprocity [Effective until July 1, 2026].

hours_per_period.quote: completed no less than 80 hours of continuing professional education as determined by Board rule during the 2-year renewal period

available.quote: Reciprocal permits to practice shall be issued to applicants who have passed the Uniform CPA Examination and hold a valid CPA certificate, license or permit to practice in a substantially equivalent state or who individually are determined to be substantially equivalent.
available.citation: § 108. Issuance and renewal of CPA permits to practice and maintenance of competency; reciprocity [Effective until July 1, 2026].

requirements.value: Applicant must have passed the Uniform CPA Examination and hold a valid CPA certificate, license or permit in a substantially equivalent state, or individually be determined substantially equivalent. Non-equivalent applicants must show: passed Uniform CPA Examination; 4 years of relevant experience within the 10 years preceding application; and fulfilled applicable CPE requirements if certificate was issued more than 4 years prior.
requirements.quote: Reciprocal permits to practice shall be issued to applicants who have passed the Uniform CPA Examination and hold a valid CPA certificate, license or permit to practice in a substantially equivalent state or who individually are determined to be substantially equivalent.
requirements.citation: § 108. Issuance and renewal of CPA permits to practice and maintenance of competency; reciprocity [Effective until July 1, 2026].

national_association.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
national_association.quote: The Board shall adopt the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination as the national examination to be taken by all applicants for licensure as certified public accountants and use the advisory grading service of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA), or its successor organization.

regulatory_model.quote: Each person who is engaged in the practice of certified public accountancy and whose principal place of business is in this State, whether as a principal or employee of a firm, shall be required to obtain and maintain a valid permit to practice certified public accountancy.
regulatory_model.citation: § 107. Requirements and qualifications for a permit to practice as a certified public accountant [Effective until July 1, 2026].

credential_type.quote: "Permit" or "permit to practice" means a permit issued by the Board to practice either public accountancy or certified public accountancy.

is_mandatory.quote: shall be required to obtain and maintain a valid permit to practice certified public accountancy
is_mandatory.citation: § 107. Requirements and qualifications for a permit to practice as a certified public accountant [Effective until July 1, 2026].

title_protection.quote: The use of the title or designation "certified public accountant" or the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card or device tending to indicate that a person is a certified public accountant shall be limited to a person who holds an active permit to practice issued by the Board

scope_protection.quote: No person or firm shall perform compilation, review or audit services, as defined by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA), except holders of a valid permit to practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception to acquire or renew a certificate or permit, or impersonated another holder, or allowed another to use their credential, or aided unlicensed practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed or knowingly cooperated in fraud or material deception in order to acquire or renew a certificate or permit to practice or be otherwise authorized to practice accountancy; or impersonated another person holding a certificate or permit to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in fraud, gross negligence, or dishonorable/unethical/unprofessional conduct intended or likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in an act of fraud or gross negligence in the practice of accounting or engaged in dishonorable, unethical or unprofessional conduct intended to or likely to deceive, defraud or harm the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a crime substantially related to accountancy.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been found guilty of or has entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to a crime that is substantially related to the practice of accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subject to disciplinary sanction, censure, or revocation/suspension of certificate or permit in another state (other than for failure to pay a registration fee).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been subject to disciplinary sanction or censured or has had the individual's certificate or permit to practice revoked or suspended in any other state for any cause other than failure to pay an annual registration fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subject to disciplinary sanction, censure, or revocation of right to practice before any state or federal agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been subject to disciplinary sanction or censured or has had the individual's right to practice revoked before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a lawful provision of this chapter or any lawful regulation or rule of professional conduct established thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated a lawful provision of this chapter or any lawful regulation or rule of professional conduct established thereunder.

definition_quote.value: "Certified public accounting" or "the practice of certified public accountancy" means the performance, or offer to perform, for a client or a potential client, by a person or firm holding itself out to the public as a CPA permit holder, of 1 or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports or financial statements, or of 1 or more kinds of management advisory, financial advisory or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.
definition_quote.quote: "Certified public accounting" or "the practice of certified public accountancy" means the performance, or offer to perform, for a client or a potential client, by a person or firm holding itself out to the public as a CPA permit holder, of 1 or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports or financial statements, or of 1 or more kinds of management advisory, financial advisory or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, an individual who offers or renders professional services, whether in person, by mail, telephone or electronic means, under this section shall be granted practice privileges in this State and no notice or other submission shall be provided by any such individual.

value: Consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the Board
Comply with this chapter and the Board's rules
Cease offering or rendering professional services if license from home state is no longer valid
Appointment of the State Board which issued their license as agent upon whom process may be served
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: An individual licensee of another state exercising the privilege afforded under this section and the firm which employs that licensee hereby simultaneously consent, as a condition of the grant of this privilege: a. To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the Board; b. To comply with this chapter and the Board's rules; c. That in the event the license from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid, the individual will cease offering or rendering professional services in this State individually and on behalf of a firm; and d. To the appointment of the State Board which issued their license as their agent upon whom process may be served in any action or proceeding by this Board against the licensee.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An applicant for initial issuance or renewal of a permit to practice under this section shall be required to register each office of the firm within this State with the Board and to affirm that all attest and compilation services rendered in this State are under the charge of a person holding an active permit to practice issued under this chapter or qualifies for the practice privilege under § 109 of this title.
attest_services_require_firm_permit.citation: § 111. Requirements for permits to practice by firms.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights, of all partners, officers, shareholders, members or managers, belongs to holders of a CPA certificate, CPA permit, or CPA license who are licensed in some state.
firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.citation: § 111. Requirements for permits to practice by firms.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Although firms may include nonlicensee owners, the firm and its ownership must comply with applicable rules promulgated by the Board.
nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.citation: § 111. Requirements for permits to practice by firms.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: Effective July 1, 2017, the Board shall by rule require as a condition to renewal of permits under this section, that firms that provide attest and/or compilation services be enrolled in a board-approved peer review program
peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.citation: § 111. Requirements for permits to practice by firms.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: Shall include reasonable provision for compliance by a firm showing that it has, within the preceding 3 years, undergone a peer review.
peer_review_max_frequency_years.citation: § 111. Requirements for permits to practice by firms.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The Board may by rule create an exception to this requirement for permit holders who do not perform or offer to perform 1 or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills ... and who make application for inactive status to the Board.
inactive_license_status_available.citation: § 108. Issuance and renewal of CPA permits to practice and maintenance of competency; reciprocity [Effective until July 1, 2026].

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm that does not have an office in this State may engage in the practice of certified public accountancy in this State through an individual practicing pursuant to the practice privilege afforded by § 109 of this title without obtaining a permit under this section or otherwise notifying the Board.
out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.citation: § 111. Requirements for permits to practice by firms.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: all attest and compilation services rendered in this State are under the charge of a person holding an active permit to practice issued under this chapter or qualifies for the practice privilege under § 109 of this title.
office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.citation: § 111. Requirements for permits to practice by firms.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda made by a permit holder or a partner, shareholder, officer, director or employee of a permit holder, incident to or in the course of rendering services to a client ... shall be and remain the property of the permit holder in the absence of an express agreement between the permit holder and the client to the contrary.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: an individual who is not a licensee of the Board shall not be prohibited the use of the following language in connection with financial statements: "I (we) have prepared the accompanying (financial statements) ... I (we) have not audited or reviewed the accompanying financial statements and accordingly do not express an opinion or any other form of assurance on them."
safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.citation: § 127. Permitted titles and safe harbor language.

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: Firms which fall out of compliance with the provisions of this section due to changes in ownership or personnel, after receiving or renewing a permit, shall take corrective action to bring the firm back into compliance within 60 days.
firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.citation: § 111. Requirements for permits to practice by firms.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Each firm with an office in this State and which intends to be or is engaged in the practice of certified public accountancy or the practice of public accountancy in this State shall be required to obtain and maintain a valid permit to practice.
firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.citation: § 111. Requirements for permits to practice by firms.

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: "Public accountant" means the holder of a permit to practice public accountancy.

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A permit holder shall furnish to permit holder's client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice: (1) A copy of the permit holder's working papers, to the extent that such working papers include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client; or (2) Any accounting or other records belonging to or obtained from or on behalf of the client
